english.title: Fail to keep sluice shut - trout / salmon
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without permission in writing granted by **(..SPECIFY..) water authority, failed to keep a sluice for drawing off water which would otherwise flow over a dam in waters frequented by salmon or migratory trout shut

(A)_[on a Sunday]_
(B)_[at all times when the water was not required for milling purposes]_

in such manner as to allow water to flow through any fish pass in or connected with the dam or, if there was no such fish pass, over the dam
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13(1) and (2) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.
